Rahul Gandhi Rules Out Congress Election Boycott

Rahul Gandhi has stated that the Congress party will not boycott elections, despite alleging "vote chori" (vote theft). He indicated that the opposition would face challenges until the public recognizes flaws in the electoral process. Separately, changes have been made to the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) withdrawal rules.
